note: Canonical contractor identities for by-contractor rankings. src/lib/contractors.ts first normalizes a raw contractor string (cut a trailing em-dash scope note, strip a trailing parenthetical, fold case and diacritics to a slug) and then looks it up here. Entries are only needed where normalization alone would split or merge firms incorrectly; everything else resolves heuristically. An entry with `members` is a joint venture: a lot is credited to the JV *and* to each member. Aliases are matched against the raw string, the em-dash-cut string and the parenthetical-stripped string, in that order, so `Webuild (Astaldi)` resolves to Astaldi before the parenthetical is discarded.
